releaseNotes: Replaces Basement color combination enumeration with direct clue-derived counts. Reads each configured Gems group and counts whole models marked ColorPuzzleVisible, waits for complete/stable clues and streamed map loading, and advances only counters that differ from their clue. Handles counter wrap and re-reads unexpected other-player changes instead of advancing cached guesses. Shows the clue counts and waits for server-confirmed completion. Preserves whole-pile Auto Farm roaming, TNT and the other puzzle stages.
